display_name: Zero-knob joint three-symbol London-proxy open cosign fade, intraday flat (multi-instrument v4; all-or-none sizing + house PF + runner refuse + complete gate contract; authorize this version only)
hypothesis: On the multi-instrument Phase-0 package H1 bars for XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD (server_clock_as_stored), restrict all analysis to the develop timestamp intersection. If the earliest joint bar of each server calendar day with server hour in {7,8,9} shows the same nonzero close-open sign on all three symbols, and all three legs admit a valid T*+1 entry with finite ATR and risk-sized lots ≥ lot_min after floor-to-step, then enter the full three-leg fade at T*+1 open with fixed ATR SL/TP and same-day flat. Partial baskets are forbidden. Zero free knobs. Account currency and P&L are USD.

prohibited_runners: any single DataFrame family runner that ignores multi_instrument block
gates_from_charter-only evaluation without joint all-three check
harness.note: Dedicated multi-instrument screen/null harness required. Generic single-frame runners must refuse this charter (validate_charter + runtime).

analysis_calendar.construction: Build the ordered set I of timestamps present in all three symbols' develop series (server_time < holdout). Drop any bar not in I for every symbol before any rule logic. Real and null both operate only on frames indexed by I. Per-symbol full calendars are forbidden for ATR/exits/equity.
analysis_calendar.m_definition: For each server calendar day D, m_D = number of joint bars in I with date D

clock_contract.source: Multi-instrument package H1 time column (Vantage MqlRates via ExportInstrumentHistory)
clock_contract.london_open_label_note: Name only: fixed server-hour window {7,8,9}; not claimed London civil time

rule.coincident_bar_T_star: On joint calendar I only: per server calendar day D, among bars in I with date D and server hour in coincident_hours_server, take the earliest. If none → no signal that day.
rule.cosign: At T*: r_S = close_S - open_S for each symbol on the joint frame; require all r_S nonzero and equal sign in {+1,-1}.
rule.entry: If cosign holds: evaluate all three legs for valid T*+1 open fill, finite atr[T*]>0, and lots after floor-to-step ≥ lot_min (see execution_contract.sizing). If ANY leg fails, skip the entire joint signal (no partial basket). If all three ok: enter all three at open of next joint bar after T* (T*+1), direction opposite cosign. Never enter at T* open/close. Never use T* high/low for SL/TP.
rule.exit: On each subsequent joint bar j >= T*+1: apply SL then TP using that bar's high/low (priority SL before TP if both touch); else if hour>=flat_hour_server force flat at close; else if j is last bar of calendar day D force flat at close (missing hour-16 / short day). No overnight into D+1.

identical_0_1_knob_rule.note: v4 freezes zero free knobs; any future free knob must be identical across symbols

window.develop_rule: server_time < holdout_start_server then restrict to timestamp intersection

joint_statistics.floating_equity: At each t in I: joint_equity(t) = sum over symbols of (realized_balance_S + open_pnl_S(t)); open_pnl uses mid/close of joint bar t and entry fill price; flat books contribute realized only.
joint_statistics.drawdown_denominator: peak joint_equity on I (running max of joint_equity)
joint_statistics.max_drawdown_pct: 100 * (peak - trough) / peak using joint_equity series on I
joint_statistics.profit_factor: joint PF = sum winning trade PNLs across three books / abs(sum losing trade PNLs), with zero-denominator semantics as profit_factor_zero_denominator (house convention).
joint_statistics.max_pf: joint PF of the sole configuration (search_cardinality=1)
joint_statistics.n_trades: sum of closed trades across three symbol books
joint_statistics.net_profit: sum of closed-trade PNLs across three books (after costs at exit booking)
joint_statistics.n_passers: 1 if joint_gate_success else 0 (never count per-symbol soft passers as primary)

profit_factor_zero_denominator.formula: pf = (gw/gl) if gl > 1e-12 else (99.0 if gw > 0 else 0.0)

shared_k_spec.day_order: ascending server calendar date over joint develop days
shared_k_spec.per_day_draw: exactly one integers draw: k = rng.integers(0, m_D) for each day D in day_order
shared_k_spec.m_D: count of joint bars in I with date D (intersection bar count only)
shared_k_spec.apply: same k applied to XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD OHLC-increment rotates for that day
shared_k_spec.identity: k=0 is identity for that day

null.algorithm: Restrict all three symbols to joint calendar I. For trial t: seed RNG with base_seed+t. For each calendar day D in ascending order with m_D joint bars: draw k~Uniform{0..m_D-1}; for each symbol apply within_day_ohlc_increment_rotate_v1 with that k on the day's joint bars; rebuild continuous OHLC; re-run rule on joint frames. Timestamps/spreads fixed.

explicitly_forbidden: inspect develop grid / joint metrics before this charter is git-committed and matches HEAD
implement family module or fixtures before adversarial freeze review approval of this charter version (charter_version=4 / v4 SHA)
route this charter through generic single-frame null_maxstat without multi_instrument joint harness
use gates.per_symbol/gates.joint nesting without top-level gates.soft (v1 defect)
unequal calendars: real ATR/exits on full symbol path while null on intersection
exits that use entry bar T* high/low or entry at T* close without T*+1 open fill
holdout selection or retune after screen
partial three-leg entry when any symbol fails ATR/lots/T*+1
force lots up to lot_min when raw_lots < lot_min
apply XAU point_size as FX sizing input
route multi_instrument_joint_v1 charters through xau_family_null_maxstat single-frame path
route multi_instrument_joint_v1 charters through xau_sealed_family_cycle generic runner

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 on joint calendar I only
execution_contract.entry_fill: open of next joint bar after T* (T*+1); if T* is last bar of day → no trade that day
execution_contract.exit_start_bar: T*+1 (entry bar); never evaluate SL/TP on T*

time_flat.if_no_hour_16_bar: force flat at close of last joint bar of calendar day D

atr.formula: TR.ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False).mean() on joint frame per symbol
atr.tr: max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close)) with prev on joint I
atr.value_used_at_entry: atr at T* on joint frame (causal through T*)

sizing.formula: risk_cash_USD = risk_pct * balance_USD; sl_distance_price = sl_atr_fixed * atr[T*]  (price units of the symbol); raw_lots = risk_cash_USD / (sl_distance_price * contract_size); lots = min(lot_max, floor(raw_lots / lot_step) * lot_step); if lots < lot_min OR atr invalid OR no T*+1 bar → leg_invalid. NEVER round up to lot_min when raw_lots < lot_min. If any leg_invalid → cancel entire joint signal (no trades that day).
sizing.point_size_role: point_size is for spread conversion (points→price) only; sizing uses contract_size and price distance, not point_value_per_lot * contract_size.

costs.spread: package spread column in points * point_size at entry (RT half+half or full RT per house simulate; pin: full RT spread cost measured at entry)
